services.name: Vercel
services.limits: Functions: 300 s default and max duration, fixed 2 GB / 1 vCPU, single region, 4.5 MB request/response body (vendor-authored). Cron limits NOT verified.
services.note: Secondary source states 'Free tier does not allow commercial usage'. vercel.com/docs/limits/fair-use-guidelines could not be fetched.

services.name: Vercel
services.perUnit: Usage beyond the included $20/month credit is billed on demand (rates not verified)
services.limits: $20/month platform fee includes $20/month usage credit; 1 deploying seat + unlimited free Viewer seats; 1 TB Fast Data Transfer and 10M Edge Requests/month included; functions up to 800 s (1800 s beta), configurable memory/CPU, up to 3 regions, 4.5 MB body. Cron limits NOT verified.
services.note: commercialUseOk inferred: Pro is the paid plan and the Hobby restriction does not apply to it.

services.name: Supabase
services.limits: 500 MB database (read-only above it), shared CPU / 500 MB RAM, 1 GB file storage, 50 MB max upload, 5 GB egress + 5 GB cached egress, 50,000 MAU, 500,000 Edge Function invocations, NO automatic backups, paused after 1 week of low activity (restorable for 1 year), 2 free projects.
services.note: Commercial use is neither stated nor banned in the sources read. The built-in Auth SMTP sends 2 emails/hour, only to team members.

services.name: Supabase
services.perUnit: Disk $0.125/GB over 8 GB; egress $0.09/GB over 250 GB; cached egress $0.03/GB over 250 GB; storage $0.0213/GB over 100 GB; MAU $0.00325 over 100k; Edge Functions $2 per 1M over 2M; extra Micro project about $10/month; PITR $100/month per 7 days retention
services.limits: Includes one project on Micro compute ($10 compute credit), 8 GB disk, 100 GB storage, 500 GB max upload, 250 GB + 250 GB cached egress, 100k MAU, daily backups kept 7 days (Storage objects NOT included in backups), never paused, spend cap available (does not cover compute, custom domain, IPv4, PITR, log drains).
services.note: Vendor describes Pro as 'For production applications'.

services.name: Resend
services.limits: 3,000 emails/month, 100 emails/day, 1 custom domain (secondary). Daily usage counts sent + received. Default API rate limit 2 requests/second (vendor-authored); batch max 100.
services.note: GET https://api.resend.com/usage returns the plan's live daily/monthly limits; use it on /ops/status.

services.name: Twilio SMS (UK)
services.limits: Per-message price, alphanumeric sender rules and whether a number is needed NOT verified (twilio.com unreachable). GSM message = 160 chars, 2 parts up to 306, non-GSM character drops a single message to 70 (UK benchmark from GOV.UK Notify).
services.note: Existing code (lib/providers/sms.ts) targets Twilio REST. Use alphanumeric sender 'DangItsHot' (10 chars; 11 max per GOV.UK Notify rules). Budget allowance $5/month for 60 SMS.

services.note: Not usable by a private installer; included only as a UK price floor reference.

recommendedStack.leanVariant: Vercel Pro $20 + Supabase Free + the same free tiers + $5 SMS allowance; only while uploads stay at or under 50 MB, storage under 1 GB and the database under 500 MB, with a nightly pg_dump and daily DB activity.

notes: recommendedMonthlyUsd = 50 is an upper bound: $45 fixed (Vercel Pro $20, Supabase Pro $25) + a $5 SMS allowance. Twilio's UK per-message price was not verified; $5 covers 60 single-part SMS at any price up to about 8 US cents.
Excluded: card-processing fees (per transaction, unverified), domain name, possible UK VAT on US-billed SaaS, GBP/USD conversion.

Card fees on £3,000 balances will exceed all SaaS costs combined: each 1 percentage point is £30 per payment. Default to bank transfer for balances; use Stripe Checkout for deposits or customers who insist on card.
Vercel Hobby is treated as not allowed for commercial use (secondary source); Pro is the minimum for a trading business.

Supabase Free has no automatic backups, a 50 MB upload cap, 1 GB storage, read-only mode above a 500 MB database, and pauses after a week of low activity. Use Pro before real customer media is uploaded.
Supabase backups (Pro) do not include Storage objects (photos, PDFs); never hard-delete customer media.
Supabase's built-in Auth SMTP is limited to 2 emails/hour and team members only; route any Supabase Auth email through Resend SMTP.
Keep SMS at or under 160 GSM characters (2 parts up to 306; any non-GSM character limits a single message to 70). Use sender 'DangItsHot' (11-character max).
